import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 60;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static long n;
    static int k;

    static int add(int x) {
        return x >= MOD ? x - MOD : x;
    }

    static int sub(int x) {
        return x < 0 ? x + MOD : x;
    }

    static int mul(int x, int y) {
        return (int)((long) x * y % MOD);
    }

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        int n;

        void init() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(a[i], 0);
            }
        }

        void set() {
            init();
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                a[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix rhs) {
            Matrix ans = new Matrix();
            ans.n = n;
            long[][] tmp = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(tmp[i], 0);
            }
            long MODLL = (long) MOD * MOD;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    for (int t = 1; t <= n; t++) {
                        tmp[i][j] += (long) a[i][t] * rhs.a[t][j];
                        if (tmp[i][j] >= MODLL) tmp[i][j] -= MODLL;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    ans.a[i][j] = (int) (tmp[i][j] % MOD);
                }
            }
            return ans;
        }
    }

    static List<List<Matrix>> F, sumP, sumS;
    static List<Integer> Num;
    static int cnt;

    static void cal() {
        Num = new ArrayList<>();
        F = new ArrayList<>();
        sumP = new ArrayList<>();
        sumS = new ArrayList<>();
        long x = n;
        while (x > 0) {
            Num.add((int)(x % k));
            x /= k;
        }
        cnt = Num.size();

        for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
            List<Matrix> fRow = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Matrix> pRow = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Matrix> sRow = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                Matrix mat = new Matrix();
                mat.n = k + 1;
                mat.set();
                for (int t = 1; t <= k + 1; t++) {
                    mat.a[t][t] = 1;
                }
                for (int t = 1; t <= k + 1; t++) {
                    mat.a[i + 1][t] = 1;
                }
                fRow.add(mat);
            }
            F.add(fRow);
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                pRow.add(new Matrix());
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                sRow.add(new Matrix());
            }
            sumP.add(pRow);
            sumS.add(sRow);
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
            sumP.get(0).set(j, F.get(0).get(j));
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < cnt; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                int idx = (j == 0) ? 0 : j;
                if (j == 0) {
                    F.get(i).set(j, sumS.get(i - 1).get(j));
                } else {
                    F.get(i).set(j, sumP.get(i - 1).get(j - 1).multiply(sumS.get(i - 1).get(j)));
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                if (j == 0) {
                    sumP.get(i).set(j, F.get(i).get(j));
                } else {
                    sumP.get(i).set(j, F.get(i).get(j).multiply(sumP.get(i).get(j - 1)));
                }
            }
            for (int j = k - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                sumS.get(i).set(j, sumS.get(i).get(j + 1).multiply(F.get(i).get(j)));
            }
        }

        Matrix ans = new Matrix();
        ans.n = k + 1;
        ans.set();
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = cnt - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < Num.get(i); j++) {
                int idx = (total + j) % k;
                ans = F.get(i).get(idx).multiply(ans);
            }
            total += Num.get(i);
            total %= k;
        }

        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
            res = add(res + ans.a[i][k + 1]);
        }
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        cal();
        sc.close();
    }
}
